# Setup und Lernziele

**Quellen:** [GitHub](https://github.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/tree/main) [Codebuch](https://github.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/blob/main/Codebuch.md)

## Laden der Programmbibliotheken

# Netzwerk einlesen

```{r setup und Netzwerk einlesen}

library(igraph)

el <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/refs/heads/main/Edgelist.csv",
  header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

nl <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/refs/heads/main/Nodelist.csv",
  header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

t <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = el,
  vertices = nl,
  directed = TRUE
)

t

```

# Visualisierung

```{r Visualisierung SNA Projekt, fig.height=9, fig.width=12}

# Visualisierung
V(s)$color <- "blue"

plot(t,
     asp=0,
     layout=layout_with_fr,
     vertex.size=degree(t)/0.3,
     edge.arrow.size=.3,
     main = "Trump Truth Social Netzwerk"
     )

```
